definitions.explanation: A small, almost transparent goby that swims up rivers to spawn in early spring. Known as a seasonal delicacy, often eaten alive ({踊|おど}り{食|ぐ}い).

examples.english: Ice gobies are in season in spring.

examples.japanese: {素魚|しろうお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り{食|ぐ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried eating ice gobies alive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{室見川|むろみがわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{春先|はるさき}→春先：32303_harusaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{素魚|しろうお}⟦{漁|りょう}→漁：31785_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: On the Muromi River in Fukuoka, ice goby fishing begins in early spring.

notes:
Also written シロウオ. The ice goby's {踊|おど}り{食|ぐ}い (eating it alive, so that it "dances") is a spring custom in Fukuoka and other places.

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{白魚|しらうお}→白魚：23991_shirauo⟧: icefish; a different fish (a salangid) that looks similar and is also eaten in spring. The names are easily confused, but the readings differ: しろうお vs. しらうお.
